bioParagraphs: For Alexx, music has always been there. Born and raised in the heart of Italy, Alexx loved music since childhood. When he was 9 years old, he asked for lessons to learn how to play his favourite instrument: the piano.

While learning to play and starting to write songs, Alexx discovered the magic of electronic music, which became the main influence on his style. He listened to dance, trance, techno, hip hop, R&B, and electronic music through the years. These styles made him wonder how familiar songs would sound with his own personal twist, and inspired him to write covers.
As he wrote cover songs, Alexx also started singing to bring a more personal feeling to his music.

descriptions.home: Discover Alexx Eon’s music: electronic covers, reimagined pop songs, and intimate performances. Watch the latest videos and meet the artist.
descriptions.bio: Meet Alexx Eon: an Italian-born musician blending piano, vocals, and electronic influences in personal interpretations of familiar songs.
